{{Quote|Kaila's a regular at some dive in Narmle.|[[Tyla Jinn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
'''Kaila Min''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kaila Min frequented [[Narmle (city)|Narmle's]] Gambling Hall on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. Around this time, Min worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and became involved in the search for the missing [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Cal Handro]] who was sought by the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and a private citizen named [[Tyla Jinn]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You can tell me about that pilot you saw.''"<br />"''Ah, I know who you are now. I'm glad you came to see me. I was beginning to wonder if you would. Listen carefully, head directly northeast. It's north of some ruins and west of a statue head. Here are coordinates if you prefer that.|Kaila Min and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] by the name of Kaila Min lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Around this time, she frequented the [[Narmle's Gambling Hall|Gambling Hall]] in [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], one of the most powerful criminal syndicate in the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she became involved in the search for a missing [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], a man by the name of [[Cal Handro]] sought by the Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance, and a friend of Handro named [[Tyla Jinn]]. Jinn, Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jevan Monsul]], and Alliance [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Veega Madish]] each sought to learn the whereabouts of Handro who vanished after his ship crash-landed on Rori. The man was also wanted by the Black Sun because he was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] a mysterious new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

Tyla Jinn, Jevan Monsul and Veega Madish each recruited [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to investigate the location of Handro's crash site and some of them collected spice samples. However, the Black Sun leaders on Rori were not willing to let anybody discover the existence of that spice. They therefore set up a trap for the spacers in order to retrieve the spice.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided}}
Kaila Min contacted Tyla Jinn, Jevan Monsul and Veega Madish and claimed she witnessed the missing pilot wandering through the wilderness of Rori. Pretending wishing to aid in Handro's rescue, Min reached out to at least one of the affected parties. In turn, they sent subordinates to travel to Rori to meet with Min to gain specific information on Handro's last known whereabouts. The spacers tasked with this responsibility met Min in Narmle's Gambling Hall, which also doubled as one of Narmle's two major [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]]. After greeting the spacers, whom she was expecting, Kaila Min provided directions to where she pretended having seen Handro, including exact coordinates which she uploaded to the spacers' [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. According to Min, she last witnessed Handro directly northeast of Narmle, north of some ruins and west of a [[Elders (Naboo)/Legends|statue head]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

Unbeknownst to the spacers however, was that the area was being surveilled by multiple members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. When the spacers embarked to investigate the location provided by Min, these Black Sun [[Initiate/Legends|initiates]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and minions violently ambushed the spacers. However, they were all defeated by the spacers' superior combat prowess. After [[Death/Legends|killing]] the band of criminals, the spacers recovered one of their datapad's which provided the location of a [[Black Sun bunker]] in the [[Vaydean Marsh]] region of Rori. The spacers ventured toward this base, with the intention of discovering further clues surrounding Cal Handro's whereabouts. The spacers eventually discovered that the Black Sun did not know anything about the pilot and was just interested by the spice.
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
[[File:KailaMin.jpg|150px|thumb|Kaila Min in Narmle's Gambling Hall]]
{{Quote|Why hello there! Is there something that I can do for you?''"<br />"''I just wanted to say ''hello'' to a lovely lady.''"<br />"''You are very sweet, but I'm waiting for someone.|Kaila Min converses with a spacer traveling through Narmle|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
Kaila Min had dark skin, [[Color/Legends|red-brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She had a kind, helpful demeanor, as evidenced by her willingness to aid in the search for [[Cal Handro]] and in her interactions with the random passers by of Narmle. However, when it came to aiding the Galactic Empire, she expected [[Currency/Legends|financial compensation]], unlike her dealings with the Rebel Alliance, whom she would be willing to assist out of a cautious altruism. This suggests she had some sympathy for the Rebellion, but she was never willing to be seen talking to a Rebel, or even contact one directly, out of fear of being associated with an organization considered to be [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] by much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Min also expressed concern for the average citizens of the galaxy, which displayed itself in her unwillingness to let someone carry out a dangerous task. During her stay on Rori, she enjoyed frequenting Narmle's Gambling Hall, which played host to an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol bar]], and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machines in the form of [[Lugjack/Legends|lugjack]] and [[Jubilee Wheel (game)|jubilee]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />

==Equipment==
During one of her visits to Narmle's Gambling Hall, Min wore black dress shoes and a [[Clothing/Legends|luxurious gown]]<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> similar to the one [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|worn]] by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during her time with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] during [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> However, unlike the darker gown worn by Padmé, Kaila Min's consisted of a light gray skirt and neck piece, and a darker shade of grey for the gown's corset and [[Limb/Legends|arm]] covers.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> She also possessed a dark grey shawl coat with red trimming, and at least one type of [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]].<ref name="TCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=More Than You Bargained For}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well, she didn't contact me directly and doesn't want to be seen talking to me. I'm a wanted man, you understand. One of those ''rebel terrorists'' and all that rot.|Veega Madish making a remark about Kaila Min, in the Rebel aligned version of this quest|<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" />}}
Kaila Min was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was added to the game as part of the second chapter of the [[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" story arc in a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] titled "More Than You Bargained For" during [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]] on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref>

The quest included three different branches for [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial]], [[W:c:swg:Rebel Alliance|Rebel]], and neutral players. While the general quest structure for each of these three options were virtually identical, there were minor variations in dialogue and in who started the quest. For instance, Jevan Monsul initiated the Imperial version of this quest, while Veega Madish and Tyla Jinn initiated the Rebel and neutral versions respectively. If the Imperial version was pursued, Kaila Min would reach out to Jevan Monsul with information about Cal Handro's whereabouts, but expect financial compensation. If the Rebel version were pursued, Min would secretly reach out to Veega Madish. Likewise, Min would reach out to Tyla Jinn, for players who were neither aligned with the Empire or Rebellion. This article leaves it ambiguous as to which of the three parties Kaila Min reached out to, or if she indeed reached out to all of them.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF" /> Eventually, the ''Secrets of the Syren'' story arc was deactivated with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' expansion for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' released on [[March 16]], [[2010]], Kaila Min received an illustration in a quest card titled ''More Than You Bargained For''. The card description erroneously referred to her as '''Kalla Min'''.<ref name="TCG" />
